label: Separated witnesses for existence, meaning, thought, experience and belief
summary: Analyst reconstruction, attribution deferred. The actual assertion and local realization premises produce the existing positive Cogito witness. Transport to existence needs a faithful episode representative in the selected existence extension. Transport to experience needs phenomenal classification of the realizing episode. A meaningful instance requires the local assertion-to-meaning bridge. A sincere assertion of the no-beliefs denial supplies a belief in its own content. The omission interpretations reject unconditional upgrades from markers to meaning or thought, from thought or represented existence to experience, and from assertion or even F6 with reason for the same denial to actual belief. The F6 control concerns the thin relation only. This evidence favors conditional, sense-matched self-defeat over the unrestricted claim that any attempt at denial guarantees the corresponding actual witness.
blocker: For actual-world application identify an actual assertion, show its mental realization, and defend the relevant local interpretation. Cognitive meaning retorsion needs the selected content to express the denial in the same domain. Existence in re and the adopted esse contract remain separate for concrete root population. F6 supplies no reason-to-belief bridge; an independently warranted actual uptake premise would reopen that route.
